witch-house-cat.title: Little Witch, Black Cat and the Haunted House

pages.text: [warmly] Once upon a Halloween night, Little Witch and Black Cat went exploring in the Haunted House. The windows glowed yellow, the floorboards went creak, and the cobwebs sparkled like silver.
pages.caption: Once upon a Halloween night, Little Witch and Black Cat went exploring in the Haunted House. The windows glowed yellow, the floorboards went creak, and the cobwebs sparkled like silver.
pages.sfx: spooky cartoon house ambience, wind outside, distant friendly owl hoot

pages.text:
[whispers] They tiptoed further in, step by step. Then, from somewhere in the dark... [pause] CREEEEAK.
[excited] "Who's there?" said Little Witch.
pages.caption: They tiptoed further in, step by step. Then, from somewhere in the dark... CREEEEAK. "Who's there?" said Little Witch.
pages.sfx: a slow creaky wooden door opening, cartoon style

pages.text:
Black Cat puffed up like a fuzzy black pom-pom, and every whisker went boing.
[nervously] "I don't like this one bit," whispered Black Cat.
[gently] "Don't worry," said Little Witch. "I know just what to do."
pages.caption: Black Cat puffed up like a fuzzy black pom-pom, and every whisker went boing. "I don't like this one bit," whispered Black Cat. "Don't worry," said Little Witch. "I know just what to do."
pages.sfx: startled cartoon cat yowl with a springy boing

pages.text:
[excited] "Abraca-boo!" shouted Little Witch, and hopped on the magic broom, which only flies backwards, and zoomed back-first into the dark with a trail of sparkles.
And there, making all that noise, was a tiny mouse in a party hat, pushing the door open with a big pink cupcake! [laughs]
pages.caption: "Abraca-boo!" shouted Little Witch, and hopped on the magic broom, which only flies backwards, and zoomed back-first into the dark with a trail of sparkles. And there, making all that noise, was a tiny mouse in a party hat, pushing the door open with a big pink cupcake!
pages.sfx: magical sparkle swoosh flying past, cartoon, playful

pages.text:
[happily] It was a Halloween party, and everyone was invited!
Black Cat purred so loudly it sounded like a tiny motorbike, and Little Witch did backwards loop-the-loops on the broom until everyone cheered.
[warmly] Happy Halloween, everybody. [whispers] The end.
pages.caption: It was a Halloween party, and everyone was invited! Black Cat purred so loudly it sounded like a tiny motorbike, and Little Witch did backwards loop-the-loops on the broom until everyone cheered. Happy Halloween, everybody. The end.
pages.sfx: cartoon party horn toot and small crowd cheering, kids Halloween

pages.caption: Once upon a Halloween night, Friendly Ghost and Silly Skeleton went exploring in the Haunted House. The windows glowed yellow, the floorboards went creak, and the cobwebs sparkled like silver.
pages.sfx: spooky cartoon house ambience, wind outside, distant friendly owl hoot

pages.text:
[whispers] They tiptoed further in, step by step. Then, from somewhere in the dark... [pause] CREEEEAK.
[excited] "Who's there?" said Friendly Ghost.
pages.caption: They tiptoed further in, step by step. Then, from somewhere in the dark... CREEEEAK. "Who's there?" said Friendly Ghost.
pages.sfx: a slow creaky wooden door opening, cartoon style

pages.text:
Silly Skeleton rattled so hard that a funny bone fell off and bounced away.
[nervously] "I don't like this one bit," whispered Silly Skeleton.
[gently] "Don't worry," said Friendly Ghost. "I know just what to do."
pages.caption: Silly Skeleton rattled so hard that a funny bone fell off and bounced away. "I don't like this one bit," whispered Silly Skeleton. "Don't worry," said Friendly Ghost. "I know just what to do."
pages.sfx: cartoon bones rattling and clattering, one bone bouncing away boing

pages.text:
[excited] "Boo-hoo-hooray!" shouted Friendly Ghost, and began to glow, brighter and brighter, like the cosiest nightlight in the world.
And there, making all that noise, was a tiny mouse in a party hat, pushing the door open with a big pink cupcake! [laughs]
pages.caption: "Boo-hoo-hooray!" shouted Friendly Ghost, and began to glow, brighter and brighter, like the cosiest nightlight in the world. And there, making all that noise, was a tiny mouse in a party hat, pushing the door open with a big pink cupcake!
pages.sfx: soft magical glow humming up, gentle bright chime at the end

pages.text:
[happily] It was a Halloween party, and everyone was invited!
Silly Skeleton danced until every single bone jingled, and Friendly Ghost played the silliest game of peekaboo anyone had ever seen.
[warmly] Happy Halloween, everybody. [whispers] The end.
pages.caption: It was a Halloween party, and everyone was invited! Silly Skeleton danced until every single bone jingled, and Friendly Ghost played the silliest game of peekaboo anyone had ever seen. Happy Halloween, everybody. The end.

[excited] "Who's there?" said Pumpkin Kid.

pages.text:
Bat zipped behind Pumpkin Kid and hung there upside down, with both eyes squeezed shut.
[nervously] "I don't like this one bit," whispered Bat.
[gently] "Don't worry," said Pumpkin Kid. "I know just what to do."

pages.text:
[excited] "Gourd-geous!" shouted Pumpkin Kid, and flashed a great big glowing grin that lit up the whole place like a lantern.
And there, making all that noise, was a sleepy little hedgehog, rolling a baby pumpkin along like a ball! [laughs]

pages.text:
[happily] It was a Halloween party, and everyone was invited!

[warmly] Happy Halloween, everybody. [whispers] The end.
